blocks.text: SINGAPORE — Jessica Pegula has withdrawn from next week’s WTA 500 Singapore Open due to a recent heavy workload of matches. “After a long and physically demanding few weeks at the U.S. Open, I’m just not quite ready to get back on court and compete at the level I expect from myself,” Pegula said on social media this week. READ: Alex Eala gets first-round bye in Singapore Open as No. 3 seed Pegula recently moved up to third on the WTA rankings, a career high.
